reply_text:
Found two issues against `main`:

1. *High — printed prices are 100× too large* (`receipt/render.py:2`). `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`; two $4.50 coffees print as `$900.00`.
   *Fix:* Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-output assertions—the current `tests/test_render.py:10` uses the same broken formatter as its expectation.

2. *Medium — receipt amounts aren’t right-aligned* (`receipt/render.py:7`). `render_line()` never calls the new `align()` helper. It pads the name instead, so amounts of different lengths end in different columns (28 versus 29 in the examples I checked), rather than column 32.
   *Fix:* Use `align(line['name'], format_money(total))` and test rendered lines with different amount lengths.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
